A huge thank you as well to those who shared their save files during the Beta phase, your support has been invaluable in helping us fine-tune the game. Thank you again for your continued support and understanding. Now, let’s see the patch note and check out the exciting new changes!

notes.title: Update Beta Phase Extended 📆
notes.notes:
Hello Fabledom community,

We wanted to let you know that the update we planned for April 8th will be delayed. While we were aiming for a release today, we’ve decided to extend the beta phase to ensure everything is in top shape for its public launch later.

In the meantime, we really need your help! If you’ve encountered any bugs during the beta, please send us your save files so we can fix them and improve the game. Your feedback is crucial in helping us deliver the best experience possible.

You can find detailed instructions on how to send your save files, logs, and report a bug in the "How to Send Your Save Files, Logs, and Report a Bug" section inside the Steam thread.

The BETA branch is still available if you’d like to keep exploring, and we really appreciate everyone who’s already submitted their files. Thanks for being a part of making Fabledom the best it can be!

Thank you so much for your patience and continued support! 🙌

notes.title: 📢 Beta Access Announcement: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
Hello Fabledom players,

Following the recent delay of the Quality of Life Update, we have decided to launch the update in Beta first on 01/04, giving you the chance to try it out a week before the full release. The beta is set to run for one week, though it could be prolonged if necessary to guarantee the optimal conditions for a successful public release. We’re targeting a full public release on 08/04 and will keep you posted with any updates. This will help us ensure everything is running smoothly, while also allowing you to experience the improvements and fixes early.

While we’ve addressed the major bugs that were causing disruptions in the game, please keep in mind that the beta version may still contain some minor issues. We appreciate your understanding. 

The beta is a great opportunity for those of you eager to test it before the full release!

How to Access the Beta
We’ll share more details on how to access the beta once it’s available, so stay tuned for that information!

If you prefer to wait for the final release with guaranteed stability, we recommend holding off until the full update is launched to everyone. We appreciate your patience, and we can’t wait to get these improvements into your hands!

Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you in-game soon!

notes.title: 🧚‍♀️ Quality of Life update - Fairies, New Buildings, and UI Scaling! 🔮
notes.notes:
Greetings Princesses & Princes, it's been a while since your Kingdoms have seen the light of an update but it's almost time!

Last July's 1.06 patch was supposed to be the last patch for Fabledom however… Your enthusiasm and love for the game made us reflect on our decision to stop post-release support and we have not one but two Quality of Life update coming up! While Grenaa Games oversaw their development, this would not have been possible without the help of Fabledom's Game Designer, Hippolyte Azalbert, and our friends at Celsius Online spearheading the development! So, without further ado, let's start with the first Quality of life update as more detail will be coming up later about the 2nd one.
 
A magical new update will arrive in your kingdom on March 26th! Get ready for Fairies, UI scaling, and brand-new buildings to enhance your kingdom. Here’s what’s in store: 

🧚‍ UI Scaling

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/448751cae0b7b46d20302d4d3a0a07bde1cc2241.gif

The long-awaited UI scaling feature is almost here! You will be able to adjust the user interface to perfectly fit larger screens, enhancing your Fabledom experience. 

🔮 New Inhabitants - Fairies! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/92261acc6dc6992ee70380b95a1385e3c90d0525.gif

Meet the Fairies, mystical creatures ready to transport goods across your realm! Unlike your Fablings, they don’t need food or sleep, making them incredibly efficient. But their magic comes at a price, they’ll only work for those who provide Prismatic Liquid and grand Fairy Towers! 

Fairies are most useful in the late game, freeing up your Fablings to focus on other tasks, whether it’s working the fields or relaxing at home! 

🧚‍ New Buildings: Fairy Tower & Fairy Pillars

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/d135f31e98cf19fd4c8bfcb93dcc2a2cc5439e75.gif
Fairy Tower: The Fairy Tower is a unique building that can house up to 5 Fairies. It will help you transport resources within a radius around the tower. This building costs a large amount of Gold, Prismatic Liquid, Planks and requires upkeep.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43475873/a0857174b54e70abd8afd12eb1876d4337f8216b.gif
Fairy Pillars: Smaller than the Fairy Tower, Fairy Pillars accommodate up to 2 additional Fairies. These can be placed anywhere and transport resources within their radius. This building costs about half as much as the Tower.

🔮 Prismatic Liquid

To summon Fairies, you’ll need to gather Prismatic Liquid. Once you have enough, these magical creatures will be ready to streamline your resource transport and leave your Fablings to handle other tasks! 

🎮 Console Update Coming Soon 

The patch will be coming to consoles later. More information will be available in the coming months! 

We hope you will enjoy these exciting new features and improvements in Fabledom. We can’t wait to see how the Fairies help shape your kingdom! Stay tuned for even more updates soon.

Long-term goals are also nice, we have added over 10 objectives that will last over 90 days, but the rewards are quite nice!

notes.title: Patch notes 🐷
notes.notes:
Princesses & Princes,

Here we go the patch notes for today!

New features:

 Workplaces in overview menu are now color-coded to improve readability.
 Can no longer block entrances to buildings.
 Added Vignette Settings
 Added Film Grain Settings
 Added AntiAliasing Settings
 Added Vegetation Wind Settings (to improve motion sickness some people reported)

 Autumn leaves FX added (leaves now fall on autumn)


Balancing:

 Stone in large stone deposits has been tripled
 Bread now costs 2 flour instead of 3
 Carry capacity for food resources has been increased
 Hunger while fetching something to eat reduced further
 Granary storage increased from 400 to 600
 Granary worker count increased from 1 to 2.
 Stockpile worker count increased from 1 to 2
 Stockpile storage increased from 300 to 375
 Witches curse a bit less punishing


Fixes:

 Fixed floating walls on cliffs.
 Fixed minor UI issues.
 Improved Fablings flickering at a distance
 Fixed issue where town houses would rotate automatically in some cases.
 Hero now spawns in creative mode
 Grass no longer spawns in water/rivers
 Fixed grass generation errors
 Fixed fountains purple shader error at low quality
 Fixed town wells purple shader error at low quality
 Fixed bug where dandallions would spawn more at medium quality
 Fixed trees not reflecting on planar reflections
 Fixed construction progress visuals on hills
 Construction priority is now more responsive, laborers will finish their current transport then change to the priority.
 Fixed farm interior invisble
 Fixed issue where resources wouldnt load in creative mode.
 Removed sheep (will be returned as soon as sheep farm is added)
 Walls now have the same material UI as other buildings.
 Fixed issue where commoner tax amount would be displayed incorrectly.
 If the hero can't reach an encounter it's now clear using tooltip.


With love,
